YOUR TABLE. YOUR GAME.

A companion for the climb.

Keep your physical board and pieces at the table. PYRA handles the question cards and a six-sided die.

  1. 01

    Build your deck

    Choose Elementary, Middle school, High school, or College. Then pick Math, English, Science, or Engineering.

  2. 02

    Take the challenge

    Draw a card, choose one answer, and check it. A correct answer unlocks one roll. After a wrong or revealed answer, draw another card.

  3. 03

    Roll, then move

    Roll the die and move your real piece using your board’s rules. Pass the device to the next player and draw again.

Want different rules? Turn on Free roll to use the die anytime. Cards don’t repeat in a deck until you’ve drawn all six.

Cards, settings, and session progress stay in this browser when storage is available. No accounts, camera, or player information required.

 A FRESH START

Start a new session?

This clears the current card, deck history, dice rolls, and session totals on this device. Your level, subject, and Free roll setting stay selected.
